About Me

Who I am

FullStack Developer

I'm a fullstack developer with solid experience in Node.js and React.js, with or without TypeScript. I also work with C, particularly in hardware integration and protocols like ccTalk, as well as REST, Socket.IO, and MQTT. I've developed projects in PHP, explored frameworks like Vue.js, AngularJS, Next.js, Vite, and Svelte, and have also experimented with Kotlin in specific contexts. Additionally, I use Python to solve practical problems, automate tasks, and explore areas like AI/ML. I enjoy experimenting with new technologies, not just out of curiosity, but because each experience helps me become better with the tools I use daily.
